Proposition
[Realization criterion and openness] 1. Proposition 8.10.2\group lamination realizationSource: thurston:page-0223, thurston:page-0224 If $\pi _1f$ is injective and preserves the relevant non-peripheral classes, every finite enlargement of a realizable lamination is realizable; $\mathcal R_f$ is open in the train-track topology.
Proof

\sketch Straighten finitely many leaves in the universal cover; distinct endpoints at infinity give disjoint geodesics. Train-track approximation and compactness of uncrumpled surfaces extend the construction to neighborhoods and arbitrary enlargements.

□
